mediatedHandoff.plan: Select the direct, --url-base, --lan, or --tailscale reachability posture and attached/default or --no-wait lifecycle before minting; snapback admin link --help exposes their conflicts without creating a claim.
mediatedHandoff.initiate: snapback admin link authenticates with the ordinary admin credential, mints a one-time fragment link, and prints that deliberately shareable link for human browser redemption.
mediatedHandoff.status: The default attached invocation polls until redemption or expiry; snapback admin link --status <claim> observes the same bounded server-side record after --no-wait.
mediatedHandoff.resume: snapback admin link --status <claim> reattaches to an outstanding or redeemed claim, while --revoke <claim> provides bounded cleanup of the issued credential.
mediatedHandoff.protectedArtifact: The issued sbcc_ console credential is delivered only to the redeeming browser; the one-time sbcl_ claim link is intentionally agent-visible and becomes inert after redemption or expiry.

entries.title: console.approval.approve
entries.mcpDeferralReason: See console.approval.request.

mediatedHandoff.plan: The browser explains that terminal approval is required and displays the bounded snapback admin approve <code> command without displaying any console credential.
mediatedHandoff.initiate: The browser requests a short-lived device/user-code pair and transfers only the user code to the terminal operator.
mediatedHandoff.status: The browser polls with its device code and observes pending or the terminal-approved terminal state.
mediatedHandoff.resume: Polling resumes until the ten-minute bound; an expired or consumed attempt starts a fresh request rather than reusing an artifact.
mediatedHandoff.protectedArtifact: The sbcc_ console credential is returned only to the browser poll; snapback admin approve receives only the user code and a value-free approved receipt.
